items.title: How Many Shares of Duke Energy, Southern Company or WEC Energy Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical retiree would need about $364,600 of Duke Energy, $374,800 of Southern Company or $374,900 of WEC Energy Group to collect $1,000 a month in dividends at today’s prices. All three cover their dividends comfortably, paying out 67% to 68% of normalized earnings in fiscal 2025, with Southern Company the least covered.
